meta.name: CCNL Dipendenti da Proprietari di Fabbricati (Confedilizia)

family.reason: Caretakers and porters of residential buildings employed by owners and condominiums (Confedilizia).

notes.text: RENEWAL 2025: CCNL signed 2025-10-30. Normative provisions from 2025-11-01; economic provisions (salary tranches) from 2026-01-01. Contract expiry 2028-10-31. Signatories: Confedilizia + FILCAMS-CGIL, FISASCAT-CISL, UILTuCS.

CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: base_salary values are the monthly conglobated tabular minimums (paga base + contingenza rolled in), as published by Confedilizia at confedilizia.it/retribuzioni-dipendenti-da-proprietari-di-fabbricati. fixed_allowances is empty for all levels. Back-calculation: B1 2026 = 1519.10 / 173 = 8.78 EUR/h; C3 2026 = 1795.94 / 173 = 10.38 EUR/h; D1 2026 = 1439.90 / 173 = 8.32 EUR/h — consistent divisor confirmed.

HOURLY DIVISOR: 173 h/month (40 h/week x 52/12). Applicable to profiles B (B1-B5), C3, C4, D (D1-D4) per Art. 60 (B profiles), Art. 62 comma 1 (C3/C4), Art. 69 commi 1-2 (D profiles) — all 40 h/week standard schedule.

A1-A9: monthly conglobated salary is available for full-time workers only. A1, A3, A5, A6, A8 work 45 hours/week (Art. 49; hourly divisor 195 under Art. 117(2)); A2, A4, A7, A9 with accommodation work 48 hours/week (Art. 43; hourly divisor 208 under Art. 117(1)). The engine still uses the agreement-wide divisor 173 for hourly calculations and cannot assign the 195/208 divisors by level. Free accommodation, electricity, water and heating under Art. 119 are not fully priced: Table A-bis prints only conventional TFR values (accommodation EUR 19.34, energy EUR 1.72, heating EUR 1.72), not a general monthly remuneration value; modelling these as an in-kind allowance would incorrectly include them in other bases. Substitute accommodation and heating depend on conditions not represented here. A-profile post-2004 seniority steps are EUR 10.00 per triennium (Art. 125); the pre-2004 frozen value and historical maturation rules require individual history. The PDF prints 2026-2028 amounts only; the open-ended 2028 period is not evidence of a new 2029 rate. C1 and C2 remain excluded (technical or administrative managers without a fixed hourly ceiling under Art. 62(2)).

limitation.remediation: Use A salaries only for full-time monthly base pay; add level-specific hourly divisors and a TFR-only in-kind valuation before calculating hourly pay or accommodation-dependent bases. C1/C2 need separate schedule evidence.

notes.text: FIRST-EMPLOYMENT C4: select C4_PRIMO_IMPIEGO only for a first-employment office clerk during at most 12 months of effective service. The engine cannot measure effective service or verify first employment; the caller must switch to C4 when eligibility expires. Elapsed calendar months are not a substitute for effective service. The published entry-rate table ends on 31 December 2028; the data model requires an open-ended final period, so a mandatory cutoff redirects to regular C4 on 1 January 2029 rather than paying the entry rate after its published end. The source does not specify an entry rate for 2029.

limitation.remediation: Caller verifies first employment and effective service and switches to C4 after at most 12 months; elapsed-month transition does not measure effective service.

notes.text: SALARY TRANCHES: three annual steps — 2026-01-01, 2027-01-01, 2028-01-01 — as published on Confedilizia official table (3-column layout: 2026, 2027, 2028). D1 is a separate row (1439.90/1468.70/1498.07); D2-D3-D4 share a combined row (1438.58/1467.35/1496.70), confirmed by parsing raw HTML from confedilizia.it.

SENIORITY INCREMENTS: 36-month cadence (triennale), maximum 12 scatti per Art. 111-114. Art. 114 sets 12 scatti triennali for D profiles. D-profile scatto = 10.00 EUR (all D levels identical, per Art. 114; source: lexplain.it/scatti-di-anzianita-contratto-portieri-custodi-e-proprietari-di-fabbricati). B/C amounts from same source.

ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only — Art. 130 'Gratifica natalizia'). Art. 130 provides tredicesima in December equal to one monthly salary; no quattordicesima provision exists in this CCNL. Confirmed via ilccnl.it full CCNL text and targeted search.

B5 SHORT SCHEDULE (art. 122 c. 2, PDF p. 75): a B5 worker with stated weekly hours below 8 receives 15% of the salario conglobato as allowance B5_ORARIO_RIDOTTO, proportioned to the hours like the conglobato. The percentage base is the conglobato alone, without scatti or individual elements (art. 122 c. 1 lett. a); a worker without stated weekly hours is treated as full time and receives nothing.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: allowance B5_ORARIO_RIDOTTO gated by Employment.weekly_hours below 8, read on 2026-11-09.

notes.text: INPS: uses 2026-terziario.json (same tax_sector as commercio-confcommercio and turismo-federalberghi).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Artt. 126, 127, 128 c. 3 - Scatti di anzianità (profili B, C, D), p. 76-78): no increment during the apprenticeship: 'L'eventuale periodo di apprendistato non sarà considerato utile agli effetti degli scatti di anzianità.' seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0. OCR of the scan; art. 36 c. 5 admits apprentices only to profiles B, C and D, whose three articles carry the same comma.
